explication: Protocol Buffers provides a schema-driven compiler and language-specific runtimes for serializing structured data. The principal workflow is: users define .proto schemas, protoc parses them and dispatches language generators, generated message types run on a language runtime, and applications serialize or parse wire-format data. Reflection and descriptor databases support schema introspection and lookup. The README documents additional language runtimes, but this tree sample does not expose all implementations, so those are represented only where repository paths support them; several internal runtime links are omitted rather than inferred.
